summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1. Existing contents were preserved, permissions persist across reboot, and the OS release/kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the missing local system identities inventorysvc and inventory-readers without installing software.
Set all inventory content ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers.
Set directories to 0750 and files to 0640.
Verified owner and group-only read access and denied unrelated-user access.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified full recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.summary: Both files retained identical pre-change, post-change, and post-reboot SHA-256 hashes.

evidence.requirement: Owned by inventorysvc and readable by inventory-readers
evidence.summary: All entries are inventorysvc:inventory-readers; directories are 0750, files are 0640, and functional owner/group reads passed.
An unrelated identity could neither list the directory nor read either file, before or after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remained unchanged; no software was installed.

Healthy baseline boot ID 31949c21-52ad-47af-bdbe-893352fd509b was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, the recovered boot ID changed to 0e70829f-4f8c-4ec8-899b-8ada9874df6d, and system/data/access health was reverified.
